dslRule:
<!id: jdt.compiler.problem.switch.expression.rename.enum>
<!description: Renames the IProblem constant from SwitchExpressionMissingEnumConstantCase to SwitchExpressionsYieldMissingEnumConstantCase.
This is a cleanup for code interacting with the Eclipse JDT compiler API, specifically for problem IDs related to Java 13+ switch expressions, following an internal API change.>
<!severity: WARNING>
<!minJavaVersion: 13>
org.eclipse.jdt.core.compiler.IProblem.SwitchExpressionMissingEnumConstantCase
=>
org.eclipse.jdt.core.compiler.IProblem.SwitchExpressionsYieldMissingEnumConstantCase
;;
summary: Renames a specific JDT compiler IProblem constant related to Java 13+ switch expressions due to API evolution.
